messages:
Aisha: Proposal: add a tiny gating enum to release metadata: stable / canary / experimental. Purpose: cheap resolver heuristics and simpler infra routing.
Ben: +1 but migration risk: many SDKs still read pin_hint/variant only.
Carmen: Namespace under release_headers.gating_label and also emit top-level gating_label for quick access.
Eli: Guardrails: cap enum to 3 values and tie telemetry to routing_decision events for A/B.
Aisha: Compatibility window: 6 months dual-write (gating_label + pin_hint), then 6 months warn-only. Header: X-Release-Gating for proxies.
Ben: Servers should emit both fields and header to minimize SDK churn.
Carmen: Example flattened manifest accepted: model_id: openlm-xxl-v3; release_headers.gating_label: canary; release_headers.epoch: 2026-03-10; pin_hint: openlm-xxl-v3-20260310.
Eli: Resolver rules: stable -> prefer stable pools; canary -> prefer canary else fallback stable; experimental -> only if caller allows.
Aisha: Add tenant opt-out for canaries and per-call allow_experimental flag.
DevOpsBot: Staging preview deployed roll-metadata-v2 (2026.03.14), health 3/3.
Ben: Migration playbook: emit both, SDKs prefer gating_label then pin_hint, CLI linter warns on mismatch, gradual enforcement 10%->50%->100%.
Carmen: I'll add manifest validation webhook to reject unknown gating_label values and emit audit events.
Eli: Telemetry: emit routing_decision with reason:"gating_label" and selected_variant; sample prompt+quality for canaries; expose per-tenant canary opt-in rate.
NetOps: Routing service needs a flag to prefer canary pools when header present; opening infra PR, ETA 3d.
Aisha: I'll draft RFC addendum with enum, header name, windows, resolver rules, telemetry contract, and lint rules. Target server patch 2026-03-21, SDK 2026-04-01.
Ben: If gating_label != pin_hint server should prefer gating_label but surface warnings in manifest status and audit logs.
Aisha: Posting addendum in #architecture for async review. :thumbsup:
